description: This file is a shell script that manages telemetry functions including inter-chip communication, daemon management, logging, configuration updates, and file transfers between ARM and ATOM systems in a network device. It includes configuration sourcing, utility functions, and case-based execution logic triggered by different events.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs a message with current timestamp to the standard output.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Restores the dropbear SSH server if not running, creating necessary configuration files.

methods.name: clearTelemetrySeekValues
methods.description: Removes temporary telemetry seek marker files, preparing for fresh operation.

methods.name: sshCmdOnAtom
methods.description: Executes an SSH command on the ATOM system with retries.

methods.name: sshCmdOnArm
methods.description: Executes an SSH command on the ARM system with retries.

methods.name: startInterChipDaemon
methods.description: Starts the telemetry daemon on the inter-chip (Atom) system via SSH.

methods.name: stopInterChipDaemon
methods.description: Sends a command to stop the inter-chip daemon.

methods.name: copyProfileToAtom
methods.description: Copies the telemetry profile configuration file to the inter-chip system.

methods.name: notifyGetGrepResultFromAtom
methods.description: Notifies the inter-chip system to perform a grep-based reporting.

methods.name: notifyProfileRemoveToAtom
methods.description: Notifies the inter-chip system to remove a specific profile.

methods.name: startT2DaemonOnAtom
methods.description: Initiates the telemetry daemon process on the inter-chip (Atom) system.

methods.name: notifyERReadyToAtom
methods.description: Notifies the Atom system that the Event Receiver is ready.

methods.name: copyLogsFromArm
methods.description: Copies logs from the ARM system to the local storage.

methods.name: copyProfileFromArm
methods.description: Copies the profile configuration file from ARM to local.

methods.name: notifyDaemonStarted
methods.description: Sends a notification to the ARM system that the daemon has started.

methods.name: notifyDaemonFailed
methods.description: Notifies the ARM system that daemon startup has failed.

methods.name: copyJsonResultToArm
methods.description: Copies processed JSON result files to the ARM system.

methods.name: copyT2CacheFileToArm
methods.description: Copies telemetry cache files from the Atom to the ARM system.
